## Summary

The retrieval pipeline reached 91% answer accuracy against 79% for the fine-tuned baseline [1].

## Where the two diverge

Fine-tuning degraded quickly when the underlying facts changed, while retrieval picked up the new facts without retraining [2].

citations.content: In our evaluation the retrieval pipeline reached 91% answer accuracy while the fine-tuned baseline reached 79% on the same question set, a 12 point gap that held across every domain we tested.

citations.snippet: Fine-tuning helped most when the domain was narrow and stable
citations.content: Fine-tuning helped most when the domain was narrow and stable, and it degraded quickly when the underlying facts changed, whereas retrieval picked up the new facts without any retraining.
